scope: 20 accepted changed parent objects in the pre-freeze working reference; two second-round proposals declined

S001-ms2lvb2v.reason: Compact isolated roadside RGB crown with one contiguous CHM footprint and no visible internal crown boundary. Propose one visible crown; source group interpretation must be checked by Xi.

S002-ms2owv9s.reason: One rounded deciduous RGB crown with coherent radiating branch texture and one corresponding CHM mound. Propose reclassification rather than cutting the crown.

S006-mspeer8c.reason: Compact oval open-grown crown with coherent branch pattern and a single bounded CHM lobe. No separate adjoining crown is visible within this group outline.

S007-mspep4dv.reason: Upper narrow rounded crown has a distinct RGB perimeter and a neck to the lower connected canopy. Extract only the upper crown at the visible neck; the lower connected crowns remain unresolved tree_group.

S007-mspesjyd.reason: Isolated oval crown on paved edge, one coherent RGB canopy and one bounded CHM mound. Propose one visible individual crown.

S007-mspetcy9.reason: Compact crown in open space with coherent central canopy texture and a single bounded CHM footprint. Lobed outer edge alone does not establish multiple trees.

S007-mspewofj.reason: Isolated rounded RGB crown beside the path, with one compact CHM mound and no distinguishable internal crown boundary. Propose one visible individual crown.

S014-mss0nwrf.reason: RGB suggests two diagonally adjacent crown lobes with a narrow shared neck. CHM confirms a raised connected vegetation footprint but does not independently resolve a decisive height saddle. Propose a partition at the RGB neck with moderate confidence; Xi must review tree identity and the approximate shared boundary.

S016-mss18t87.reason: Compact rounded crown below the building edge, one RGB crown outline and one bounded CHM footprint. Provisional single-crown interpretation pending comparison of ORIGINAL XZ with independent TW labels.

S017-mss1nobm.reason: The right-hand compact green RGB crown has its own perimeter and differs in texture from the left canopy. Extract the right crown at the narrow connection; retain the left connected canopy as unresolved tree_group.

S019-mss2617q.reason: Compact oval roadside crown with coherent RGB canopy texture and one bounded CHM mound. No visible internal division; propose single visible crown.

S020-mss2i41d.reason: Small compact rounded roadside RGB crown with one bounded CHM mound. Provisional one-crown interpretation; retain original XZ for ORIGINAL XZ-TW comparison.

S020-mss2igg6.reason: Compact isolated RGB crown beside the roof corner with a single bounded CHM footprint. Provisional one-crown interpretation pending ORIGINAL XZ-TW comparison.

S020-mss2irmn.reason: Compact rounded RGB crown beside roofs with one coherent CHM mound and no visible internal boundary. Provisional one-crown interpretation pending ORIGINAL XZ-TW comparison.

S001-ms2lqiho.reason: Second RGB/CHM review: one compact green crown against surrounding ground, reaching the lower site edge, supported by a raised CHM patch (max 4.68 m). Proposed single visible clipped crown; moderate confidence and explicit tile/site-edge truncation, not a complete crown or verified stem count.

S004-ms2ppqgf.reason: Second RGB/CHM review: an isolated small oval green crown against open ground, with one raised CHM patch (max 4.21 m); no visible junction between separate crowns. Proposed single-crown category correction preserving the outline; moderate confidence due coarse RGB and low height.

S007-mspevauw.reason: Second RGB/CHM review: the broad central green crown has a coherent perimeter against open ground and continuous texture, supported by a single broad height mound (max 11.93 m). Proposed whole-outline single visible crown; moderate confidence because the left/lower lobes could reflect crown branches or adjoining vegetation.

S008-mspfzo9n.reason: Second RGB/CHM review: a coherent grey-green crown texture inside the existing perimeter, with one broad raised CHM mound (max 16.55 m) and no clear internal crown boundary. Proposed whole-outline single crown; moderate confidence because adjoining woodland limits independent perimeter interpretation.

S009-mspgeven.reason: Second RGB/CHM review: one compact dark-green crown with a coherent visible perimeter and no repeatable internal division; CHM supports one raised mound (max 6.00 m). Reclassify the whole existing outline as a single visible crown, with moderate confidence and no claim of verified stem identity.

S010-mspgnaw8.reason: Second RGB/CHM review: one compact green crown with a coherent outer edge and central height mound (CHM max 12.79 m); no visually repeatable two-crown division. Proposed single visible crown, moderate confidence; multiple stems are not independently verified.

author_statement_english_translation: The visually clear groups may be changed to individual trees.
translation_note: English translation for repository presentation; the original statement is retained only in the local historical record.
round2_user_direction: Accept six specified single-crown revisions; decline the other two, while preserving them in the comparison gallery.
